Password Reset
Steps to be
Performed at Panel

Recover Password
1. To Perform the Password Reset you must generate the challenge file
using the Recover Password option.
2. Tap on Menu (3 horizontal lines in the upper left corner)

Recover Password
2. Tap on SETTINGS

Recover Password
3. Tap on USER ACCOUNTS

Recover Password
4. Tap on Recover Password.

Recover Password
5. Tap on CANCEL if USB is not plugged into the panel.

Recover Password
6. Tapping on “CANCEL” Redirects you back to the User Accounts Page

Recover Password
7. Tap on CONTINUE if USB is plugged into the panel.

Recover Password
8. Tap on[…] symbol to browse the USB

Recover Password
9. To copy to root
• Tap on[…] symbol again to copy to the root folder of the thumb drive

Recover Password
10. Copy to root
• With the Root Folder selected, tap on COPY

Recover Password
11. Copy to root
• Once copied to Root successfully, tap on OK.

Recover Password
12. Copy to folder instead of Root drive
• Tap on the folder that you want to copy the file to

Recover Password
13. Copy to folder
• Once the User Folder is selected, tap on COPY

Recover Password
14. Copy to folder
• Once copied to selected folder is successful, tap on OK

Recover Password
• A .txt file will be created named
Password_Reset_Request_[Nodenumber]_[SerialNumber].txt
• Example Password_Reset_Request_1_SNX0000031.txt
• Email that file to Notifier.Tech@Honeywell.com and they will email you
back a .txt file
• Put the .txt file that Tech Support emails to you on a thumb drive and put
the thumb drive into the panel that you did the recover password option
on
• The serial number of the panel must match the serial number of the .txt
file

Change Password
Steps to be
Performed at Panel
User End

Change Password
• Go to Menu > SETTINGS > User Accounts
1. Tap on “Change Password”.

Change Password
2. When the below window appears, tap on Continue.

Change Password
• If the USB is plugged into the panel, tapping Continue autodetects the
response file on the USB .
• Tapping on CANCEL redirects you back to Menu.

Change Password
3. After tapping CONTINUE, if the Auto detection of the response file is
successful the user is redirected to the change password window

Change Password
4. If the Auto detection fails, an error message appears. Tap Dismiss.

Change Password
5. Tap on [. . .] symbol to search for the file for verification

Change Password
6. If the USB is plugged into Panel, the below window appears.
• Select the folder where the signed.txt file received from Tech Support
was copied to.

Change Password
7. Tap on “Verify”.

Change Password
8. If verification is successful, you will be redirected to change the password

Change Password
9. Tap the drop-down arrow next to Username and select Master. Enter
the new Password then tap on Change Password

Change Password
10. If successful, you will get an Operation completed successfully message.
Error Messages

Error Conditions
1. ERROR -1: The Below Pop-Up is displayed when No USB is found

Error Conditions
2. ERROR -2: The below Pop-Up is displayed if user tries to change password
before doing the reset.

Error Conditions
3. ERROR -3: The below Pop-Up is displayed if File Verification fails

Error Conditions
5. ERROR -4: If File Verification failed for the max attempts, Perform
Recover password.

Error Conditions
6. ERROR -5: Trying to use the same Recover password file more than
once results in the below error.

Error Conditions
7. ERROR -6: Waiting longer than 30 days to reset the password will
give you the below error
Thank You

NWS gateway | For the NWS gateway, the 20 digit cryptic code may be obtained by following these steps: The Web Server requires the use of TCP/IP port 8888; for example, if the Web Server is located at 123.45.67.89, a Web Server user will type into the browser address field: http://123.45.67.89:8888/ After 3 unsuccessful attempts to login to the NFN Web Server you will get a 20 digit code. Network Control Station (NCS) | In order to decode the password in a Network Control Station (NCS) The following must be done. The user while the NCS software is still running must hit the “Windows Flag Button” on keyboard and click on the “Show Desktop” icon; on the windows taskbar. Next double click on “My Computer” icon. Next double click on Local Disk (C:) Navigate to and copy C:/Notifier/NCS/admin.mdb; to a flash drive. That file must sent in for decoding.
